goal: Predict the native H3 text condition raw H sequence from music, with the entire same adapter executed during deployment
not_a_repeat_of: old normalized pooled CLIP global token injection
teacher: existing native contextual raw H action tail [L,5120], reference image prefix retained separately
student: existing raw-H adapter checkpoint continued; full dense MusicFM and structural image context -> raw H action tail
backbone_scope: public MusicFM remains frozen eval; this controlled loss comparison changes adapter supervision only

loss.anchor: raw MSE divided by train teacher energy + log length MSE
loss.contrastive: same-reference-context correct/wrong-nonidentical-caption/actual-silence three-way InfoNCE on actual predicted raw sequence
loss.sequence_similarity: per-token cosine matrix -> bidirectional soft-Chamfer logmeanexp temperature0.1, then candidate temperature0.07
loss.loss_sampling: up to64 evenly spaced valid teacher positions, identical indices for all student branches
loss.train_only_mean_std: used only for loss computation, never applied to deployed raw H

execution.current_stage: audited existing targets/features load on N5GPU7, no reported training updates yet
execution.formal_pair: same initialization MSE-only versus H sequence contrastive, each train1800/val200/1875 updates; starts only after implementation sanity checks

acceptance: Complete weight and cached/online checks, then same-context correct music superiority over wrong/zero with raw amplitude and predicted length preserved; generation only for a candidate passing music-dependency checks
constraints: No external semantic action/identity prompt; H3 frozen; native reference and retake use identical silence; no model weights or media published
